features.label: Liner sizing
features.text: Choose the liner size that matches your collar's neck circumference size

features.label: Cotton comfort layer
features.text: Soft cotton liner sits between the skin and the rigid foam shell for added comfort

features.label: Easy hygiene changes
features.text: Lets caregivers change the liner with physician permission without removing the collar

features.label: Philadelphia collar compatible
features.text: Designed exclusively for use with the Ossur Philadelphia Tracheotomy Collar

features.label: Supports skin protection
features.text: Regular liner changes help reduce the risk of skin irritation beneath the collar

features.label: Care instructions
features.text: Wipe the collar with a damp cloth and mild soap and air dry

measurement: Choose the liner size that matches the neck circumference size already used for your Philadelphia Tracheotomy Collar. Small/XS fits 10 to 13 in. (25 to 33 cm), Medium fits 13 to 16 in. (33 to 41 cm), and Large fits 16 to 19 in. (41 to 48 cm). The Small/XS liner fits both X-Small and Small collar sizes. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
